display.purpose: Hero countdown timer (MM:SS) and kiosk headers.

body.purpose: Descriptive copy, stop names, and event logs.

mono.purpose: Timestamps, vehicle IDs, and block_id tags.

shadows.name: card-glow
shadows.purpose: Deep floating depth for glassmorphism card containers.

components.name: ETA Countdown Panel
components.description: Displays hero MM:SS predictive arrival countdown with sub-component breakdown.
components.css: .ds-card-eta { background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9); border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center; } .ds-label { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-time { color: #f8fafc; font-size: 48px; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; }

narrative.overview: TransitSense is an edge-first public transit intelligence identity engineered for maximum readability under intense outdoor sunlight, high-movement environments, and quick 10-foot glance scanning.
keyCharacteristics: Outdoor Sunlight Readability (Slate 950 obsidian background + pure crisp white text)
Glanceable Color Coding (Emerald, Amber, Rose status bands)
Tactile Route Pill Badges (Bold high-visibility route numbers 101, 16C, 24E)
Glassmorphism Depth (Semi-transparent slate containers with backdrop-blur-md)

rules.name: The One Flash Rule
rules.body: Color flashes fire only on state changes and return to clean slate within 2 seconds.

rules.name: The Monospace Time Rule
rules.body: All timestamps, countdown numbers, and trip deltas must use monospace typography.

rules.name: The Glass Surface Rule
rules.body: All card containers use semi-transparent bg-slate-900/90 with backdrop-blur-md and 1px border.

dos: Do maintain high contrast between text (#f8fafc) and dark background (#020617).
Do use JetBrains Mono for all live numbers, timestamps, and minute deltas.
Do highlight desaturated prior leg vs active inbound leg on the map.
donts: Don't use low-contrast grey text directly on bright colored backgrounds.
Don't hardcode fake values in UI components — always connect to live stream.
